title: Leke Maula ka Naam Zainab ka
body:
Leke maula ka naam zainab ka
likh raha hu kalam zainab ka
Sub pe wajib hai saath zahra ke
karna bas ehteram zainab ka
Farsh e majlis hussain maula ki
hai ye sub intezaam zainab ka
Ambiyao'n se hur ye kehne laga
mujhko aaya salam zainab ka
Mashwera deti hai imamo ko
allah allah maqam zainab ka
Naaz tujhko bhi hoga kismat pe
tu bhi banja ghulam zainab ka
Kaa'np utthega qalb batil ka
sunke zor e kalam zainab ka
Sar se chadar na hatne paye kabhi
sunlo behno payam zainab ka
Padhta rehta hu mai qasida zaheer
raat din subho sham zainab ka
